comment: Catalyzes the exchange of the alpha-aminoadipyl side chain of IPN with a phenylacetyl moiety, to yield penicillin G.

changelog.comment: New entry. Added original ref, minor corrections to reaction descriptions. Replaced Uniref database ref with Uniprot ID.

reactions.description: Transacylation of side chain of isopenicillin N in the biosynthetic pathway of penicillin G.
Transacylation of isopenicillin N to penicillin G (benzylpenicillin) by replacement of alpha-aminoadipyl side chain with phenylacetly moiety.
